Read without changing your agreement.
Before the meal, the host may cancel. The meal is cancelled if recruitment closes below its minimum, or later falls below it before the start.

Everyone pays at the restaurant. Fancy takes no deposit and issues no refund. The host contacts the restaurant.

Cancelling the meal does not close its existing group chat.
